question.wording: Is this a gift of cash or by check for which the taxpayer keeps neither a bank record nor a written record from the charity?

options.label: Yes — no bank record and no written record
No — a bank record or written record is kept

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this a gift of cash or by check for which the taxpayer keeps neither a bank record nor a written record from the charity?

citation.wording: For any contribution made in cash, regardless of the amount, you must maintain as a record of the contribution a bank record (such as a canceled check or credit card statement) or a written record from the charity.
